items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I've heard Elvin Jones and Art Blakey roll it, but they were no way in his league when it comes to making a roll...or press roll on that parade drum.

ctx.x: You were describing him before we started taping.

Right. He was the drummer with the Rabbit Foot Minstrel Show. And he used to lead the parades. See, when the minstrel shows came to town, they would parade through the city, drumming up business for that night's performance. And he would lead the band. Well, you've never seen anybody who play a parade drum the way he could play one. And he could roll a drum than anybody I've ever heard. And I've heard Elvin Jones and Art Blakey roll it, but they were no way in his league when it comes to making a roll...or press…
